title: AnimationPlayer.play_section_with_markers bug while playing between 2 section
body: ### Tested versions Godot Engine v4.5.stable.steam.876b29033 - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 ### System information Godot Engine v4.5.stable.steam.876b29033 - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 ### Issue description When a section that is later in the timeline finishes playing, and then a section that is earlier in the timeline is played subsequently, the AnimationPlayer will only play the last frame of the earlier section directly, instead of playing the section normally from start to end. ### Steps to reproduce For example, I divided an animation into two sections using a casting marker: The section from frame 0 to the casting marker is named Section A. The section from the casting marker to the end of the animation is named Section B. Normal Behavior (Expected) When I play Section A first and then play Section B, the animation works correctly: it starts playing from frame 0, proceeds to the casting marker (completing Section A), and then continues playing from the casting marker to the end of the animation (completing Section B). Abnormal Behavior (Bug) However, if I attempt to play Section A again right after Section B finishes, an unexpected issue occurs: the AnimationPlayer seems to directly seek to the casting marker (the end boundary of Section A) instead of playing Section A normally from frame 0 to the casting marker. As a result, Section A fails to play in full and only the final frame of the section is displayed. ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0d4630bf-3df8-4a09-9347-f85ac09d17bf) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) ```gdscript extends Node3D @export var animation_player: AnimationPlayer @export var label_cur_pressed: Label func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void: if event.is_action_pressed("ui_up"): animation_player.play_section_with_markers("mixamo_com", "", "casting") label_cur_pressed.text = "up" if event.is_action_pressed("ui_down"): animation_player.play_section_with_markers("mixamo_com", "casting", "") label_cur_pressed.text = "down" if event.is_action_pressed("ui_left"): animation_player.play_section_with_markers("mixamo_com", "", "2") ``` MRP still too big to upload. You can simply make your own test project.
